detail.longDescription: python and fellow programming sickos in general: what's your personal opinion/take on functions that modify the input object? Say I have a function: ``` def get_website_id(website) -> str:     ...     website.id = website     return id ``` would you consider that an anti-pattern?  It cuts down on bookkeeping at the call site (so that I don't have to manually set the ID every time) and yet, something inside of me is slightly recoiling at the idea that the `website` object is modified as a side effect of the function.  Would a better name be a good way to handle it, or just a totally different pattern in general? # python # programming
